title: MOTION (HARRIS-DAWSON - BLUMENFIELD) relative to funding for the installation of speed humps on 60th Street between Crenshaw Boulevard and 8th Avenue.
text:
[Council File 26-1408; CD 8]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (HARRIS-DAWSON - BLUMENFIELD) relative to funding for the installation of speed humps on 60th Street between Crenshaw Boulevard and 8th Avenue.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $16,000 from the Pipeline Franchise Revenue portions of the Council District 8 Real Property Trust Fund No. 690 to the Transportation Fund No. 100/94, Account No. 3040 (Contractual Services) for the installation of speed humps on 60th Street between Crenshaw Boulevard and 8th Avenue.
AUTHORIZE the Department of Transportation to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
summary: Council motion to transfer $16,000 from the District 8 trust fund to install speed humps on 60th Street between Crenshaw Boulevard and 8th Avenue.

locations.text: 60th St & Crenshaw Blvd, Los Angeles, CA
